subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: ʿAmidah ('standing') bears three senses: standing up or still; desisting and ceasing ('she ceased from bearing'); and enduring and abiding ('his righteousness endures forever'). Of God only the last applies — 'His feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives' means His causes shall be made firm. The literal sense is reserved for the cross-reference on regel ('foot'). Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.note: Equivocal across three senses: (1) standing up or still, (2) desisting/ceasing, (3) enduring/abiding. Of God only the third applies.
The sense in which 'standing' is used of God: that which 'remained and abided and did not change.' 'His feet shall stand' means His causes (i.e. His effects) are made firm.
Maimonides defers the figure 'His feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives' to the later chapter on the equivocity of regel ('foot'), reading the 'feet' as His causes/effects.

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלת'אלת' עשר — עמידה
עמידה אסם משתרך. יכון במעני אלקיאם ואלוקוף: בעמדו לפני פרעה, אם יעמד משה ושמואל, והוא עומד עליהם.
aligned.en: ʿAmidah is an equivocal noun. It bears the sense of standing up and standing still: 'when he stood before Pharaoh' (Gen 41:46); 'though Moses and Samuel stood' (Jer 15:1); 'and he was standing over them' (Gen 18:8).

pairs.en: ʿAmidah is an equivocal noun
It bears the sense of standing up and standing still
when he stood before Pharaoh
though Moses and Samuel stood
and he was standing over them

aligned.ja: ויכון במעני אלנכול ואלכף: כי עמדו לא ענו עוד, ותעמד מלדת.
aligned.en: And it bears the sense of desisting and ceasing: 'for they stood still and answered no more' (Job 32:16); 'and she ceased from bearing' (Gen 29:35).

pairs.en: And it bears the sense of desisting and ceasing
for they stood still and answered no more
and she ceased from bearing

aligned.ja: ויכון במעני אלת'באת ואלבקא: למען יעמדו ימים רבים, ויכלת עמוד, עמד טעמו בו — ת'בת ובקי ולם יתגיר, וצדקתו עומדת לעד — ת'אבתה באקיה.
aligned.en: And it bears the sense of endurance and abiding: 'that they may endure many days' (Jer 32:14); 'and you will be able to endure' (Exod 18:23); 'its taste stayed in it' (Jer 48:11) — it remained and abided and did not change; 'and his righteousness endures forever' (Ps 111:3) — fixed and abiding.

pairs.en: And it bears the sense of endurance and abiding
that they may endure many days
and you will be able to endure
its taste stayed in it
it remained and abided and did not change
and his righteousness endures forever
fixed and abiding

aligned.ja: וכל עמידה ג'את פי אללה תעאלי הי מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר: ועמדו רגליו ביום ההוא על הר הזיתים — ותת'בת אסבאבה, אעני מסבבאתה. וסיבין ד'לך ענד ד'כר אשתראך רגל.
aligned.en: And every 'standing' that comes regarding God, may He be exalted, is of this last sense: 'and His feet shall stand on that day upon the Mount of Olives' (Zech 14:4) — and His causes shall be made firm, I mean His effects. This will be explained when the equivocity of regel ('foot') is treated.

pairs.ja: וכל עמידה ג'את פי אללה תעאלי הי מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר
pairs.en: And every 'standing' that comes regarding God, may He be exalted, is of this last sense

pairs.ja: ועמדו רגליו ביום ההוא על הר הזיתים
pairs.en: and His feet shall stand on that day upon the Mount of Olives
and His causes shall be made firm, I mean His effects

pairs.ja: וסיבין ד'לך ענד ד'כר אשתראך רגל
pairs.en: This will be explained when the equivocity of regel ('foot') is treated

aligned.ja: ומן הד'א אלמעני קולה לה תעאלי: ואתה פה עמד עמדי, אנכי עמד בין י״י וביניכם.
aligned.en: And of this sense is what He, may He be exalted, said to him: 'but as for thee, stand thou here by Me' (Deut 5:28); and 'I stood between the Lord and you' (Deut 5:5).

but as for thee, stand thou here by Me
and 'I stood between the Lord and you'
